summary: Iteration 13 retest of iteration-12 fixes (Phase 4c). Backend: test_phase4c_growth.py extended with TestIter13Fixes (blank create mirrors frontend payload, submit counted once, clean_path UUIDs, collect stores /match/:id, re-subscribe clears confirmed_at + new confirm e-mail next minute) -> 29/29 pass. Frontend (1920 + 390): FOUND AND FIXED a 1-word bug that made the cookie-wait fix ineffective (Layout passed waitForCookies={cfg.cookies.enabled} but site config key is cookies.banner, so popups still appeared before consent and blocked cookie-accept at 390px; Playwright click timed out). After fix: no /api/popups call and no popup while banner unanswered, cookie-accept/reject clickable at 390, popup appears right after 'No thanks' and after 'Allow optional'. Popup form submit sends only POST /submit (no client submit event) and stats show submit=1. Beacon: exactly 1 POST /analytics/collect per route change (/, /teams, /finder, /match/<uuid>), 0 on /sign-in, /unsubscribe, /newsletter/confirm, /admin. Admin: New popup (no template) -> 200, 'Popup created as a draft', editor opens with 'Your headline'; Who tab hint reads '/* = every page'; Analytics Sources empty state shows utm_source hint at 7/30/90; E-mail list pending re-subscribed row shows Confirmed 'No data'. Regression OK: footer form (disabled until consent, neutral message), confirm + unsubscribe pages (valid token flow + missing token), Integrations cards + webhook drawer, Health alerts 'No open alerts' + Check now, all 6 Analytics cards, no 4xx/5xx.
